text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the Kikuka-sho began, Fuji Kiseki 
uncharacteristically provoked her fellow 
competitor, Mayano Top Gun. The sparks 
flying between the two sent the crowd into 
a frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, this was merely "spice" to liven 
up the race. Fuji Kiseki had staged the 
performance with her cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The excitement at the venue continues to 
rise... Filled with high spirits, they 
head out to face the race.
